def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    n = len(customers)
    if n == 0:
        return []

    # Clarke-Wright savings with capacity and end-merge only (deterministic)
    routes = []
    route_of = {}
    route_load = []
    for i in customers:
        routes.append([i])
        route_load.append(demands[i])
        route_of[i] = len(routes) - 1

    savings = []
    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    for s, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, -1)
        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri < 0 or rj < 0 or ri == rj:
            continue
        ri_list = routes[ri]
        rj_list = routes[rj]
        load = route_load[ri] + route_load[rj]
        if load > capacity:
            continue

        i_front, i_back = ri_list[0], ri_list[-1]
        j_front, j_back = rj_list[0], rj_list[-1]

        merged = False
        if i_back == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_back == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list
            merged = True
        elif i_front == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True

        if not merged:
            continue

        routes[ri] = new_route
        route_load[ri] = load
        for node in rj_list:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = None

    routes = [r for r in routes if r is not None]

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
        return c

    # Local improvement: conservative relocate (single-node), then deterministic 2-opt within routes,
    # then a limited feasible inter-route swap (one node each), all strictly improving.
    loads = [sum(demands[node] for node in r) for r in routes]
    costs = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]

    def try_relocate(max_passes=3):
        nonlocal routes, loads, costs
        R = len(routes)
        for _ in range(max_passes):
            improved_any = False
            R = len(routes)
            for a in range(R):
                ra = routes[a]
                if not ra:
                    continue
                base_cost_a = costs[a]
                Lra = len(ra)
                for idx in range(Lra):
                    node = ra[idx]
                    # compute cost of removing node from ra by rebuilding affected edges
                    left = ra[idx - 1] if idx - 1 >= 0 else depot
                    right = ra[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < Lra else depot
                    rem_delta_a = -matrix[left][node] - matrix[node][right] + matrix[left][right]
                    new_cost_a = base_cost_a + rem_delta_a
                    new_ra = ra[:idx] + ra[idx + 1:]
                    # try insertion into another route
                    for b in range(R):
                        if b == a:
                            continue
                        rb = routes[b]
                        if not rb:
                            continue
                        if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                            continue
                        base_cost_b = costs[b]
                        Lrb = len(rb)
                        best_delta = None
                        best_p = None
                        # insert after position p-1, before p (p in 0..Lrb)
                        for p in range(Lrb + 1):
                            ins_left = rb[p - 1] if p - 1 >= 0 else depot
                            ins_right = rb[p] if p < Lrb else depot
                            ins_delta_b = -matrix[ins_left][ins_right] + matrix[ins_left][node] + matrix[node][ins_right]
                            total_delta = (new_cost_a + (base_cost_b + ins_delta_b)) - (base_cost_a + base_cost_b)
                            if best_delta is None or total_delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(total_delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and p < best_p):
                                best_delta = total_delta
                                best_p = p
                        if best_delta is None or best_delta >= -1e-12:

                        costs[b] = route_cost(new_rb)
                        improved_any = True

                        break

                    break
            if not improved_any:

            R = len(routes)

                if improved_any:
                    break
            if not improved_any:

    def try_inter_swap(max_checks=2000):
        nonlocal routes, loads, costs
        checks = 0
        R = len(routes)
        best_improved = True
        while best_improved and checks < max_checks:

                    base_cost_b = costs[b]

        # Precompute deterministic candidate neighbors list by distance
        cand_by = {}
        for i in customers:
            # all customers sorted by distance from i, tie by id
            lst = sorted(customers, key=lambda j: (matrix[i][j], j))
            cand_by[i] = lst

        unassigned = set(customers)
        routes = []

        for start in ordered:
            if start not in unassigned:
                continue
            if demands[start] > capacity:
                # infeasible singleton; still return something deterministic
                routes.append([start])
                unassigned.remove(start)
                continue

            route = [start]
            load = demands[start]
            unassigned.remove(start)

            while True:
                cur = route[-1]
                candidates = cand_by.get(cur, [])
                chosen = None
                for nxt in candidates:
                    if nxt in unassigned and load + demands[nxt] <= capacity:
                        chosen = nxt
                        break
                if chosen is None:
                    break
                route.append(chosen)
                load += demands[chosen]
                unassigned.remove(chosen)
            routes.append(route)

        return routes

    # Build two solutions, improve, pick best
    r1 = build_clarke_wright()
    r1 = apply_improvement(r1)

    r2 = build_nearest_chain()
    r2 = apply_improvement(r2)

    def total_cost(rs):
        s = 0
        for r in rs:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

    c1 = total_cost(r1)
    c2 = total_cost(r2)

    if c2 < c1 - 1e-12:
        return r2
    if c1 < c2 - 1e-12:
        return r1

    # tie-breaker deterministically: fewer routes then lexicographic
    if len(r2) < len(r1):
        return r2
    if len(r1) < len(r2):
        return r1

    def signature(rs):
        # sort routes by first node then lexicographically
        sr = []
        for r in rs:
            sr.append((r[0] if r else None, tuple(r)))
        sr.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
        return tuple(x[1] for x in sr)

    return r2 if signature(r2) < signature(r1) else r1
